result.stdout:
Usage: lunet [options] <command>
  -h, --help                 Show this message and exit
  -v, --version              Show the version of this command
  -d, --define=VALUE         Defines a site variable. Example --define my_variable=5.
  -o, --output-dir=VALUE     The output directory of the generated website. Default is 'www'
  -i, --input-dir=VALUE      The input directory of the website content to generate from. Default is '.'
      --stacktrace           Shows full stacktrace when an error occurs. Default is false.
  init                       Creates a new website
  new                        Creates a new content for the website from an archetype
  config                     Displays the configuration variables from an existing config or the defaults
  clean                      Cleans temporary folder
  serve                      Builds the website, runs a web server and watches for changes
  build                      Builds the website
Use `lunet --help` for usage.
